# Weak saturated traces: complete first-reserve classification for five pair-root types

Prospective theorem and frozen verification contract, OPEN pending scientific closeout. Independently reviewed analytically; no new scientific enumeration executed before freeze. Parent9c21a8ef506b349c7afd3b118a5ef0eac7f4a0bc. Original floors, palette and protected hidden family remain fixed. BroadC3/generalC4/native observation/access/source/outcome/committed progress remain supplied and OPEN.

## Setting and claimed classification
Five types0..4, ten pair roots, maximum M_i all four pairs incident to i. Source has t>=1 original labels per type. Graph G declares floor2t on its edges, floor1 on other pair roots. Use (e,n_0,...,n_4), with e empty count. Universal safety is inherited original floors, original maximal-footprint domination and core hitting number<=4.

For t=1, a first reserve is reachable iff G has an isolated vertex, equivalently a static reserve exists. For t>=2, a first reserve is reachable iff a static reserve exists AND minimum degree(G)<=1. In every reachable case some first reserve has FOUR unchanged actual original maximal labels covering all roots. Thus forced protection movement before ANY first reserve is absent throughout this entire five-type graph/multiplicity family, including its redundant maxima. This is not a general theorem for other footprint families or nonuniform source multiplicities.

For t>=2, the statically feasible but unreachable graphs are exactly the20 labelled graphs consisting of K23, with either no edge or one edge added between its two degree-three vertices. Their static minimum is4t+1 and their source5t labels all stay active by the preceding fingerprint theorem. All other no-reserve cases are statically obstructed.

## Static certificates and graph dichotomy
Any safe static core expands each nonempty label to an original maximum. Hence static reserve existence reduces exactly to nonnegative type counts with total<=5t-1, all pair floors and at least four occupied types. Conversely an admissible maximal assignment is safe with coretau4.

An isolated vertex permits deletion of one source label at that type in4 toggles, any t>=1. Four original labels of the other types remain fixed and cover every pair root. Four is an optimal first-vacancy cost because every original label has four incidences.

When t=1, any static reserve must have exactly four active labels occupying four distinct types. The missing type must be isolated in G, since its edge to any neighbor would have cardinality1 below floor2.

For a graph on five vertices with no isolated vertex, exactly one of the following alternatives is needed (certificates may not be unique):
(A) a spanning five-cycle or a triangle plus a disjoint edge;
(B) an independent set I with |I|>|N(I)|, specifically a four-leaf star, or |I|=3 and |N(I)|=2.
They cannot coexist. A spanning five-cycle has independence number2; a triangle plus edge allows independent sets of at most2. A star has an independent four-set. A three-set as in(B) is independent.

Elementary existence proof: maximum matching has size1 or2. If size1, all graph edges intersect pairwise; such a family is a star or a triangle. A triangle cannot coexist with the remaining two nonisolated vertices without a disjoint edge, so the graph is the spanning star. If size2, choose matched edges ab,cd and unmatched vertex v. If v is adjacent to both endpoints of one matched edge, there is a triangle plus the other matched edge. Otherwise v has one or two neighbors, at most one in each matched pair. If it has neighbors a,c, and bd is an edge, v-a-b-d-c-v is a spanning five-cycle. If bd is absent, {v,b,d} is independent. If v has only neighbor a, then bc and bd cannot both exist without giving triangle bcd plus edge va. Choose c or d not adjacent to b; it and v,b form an independent three-set. Its neighborhood has size at most2 and is nonempty. Neighborhood size1 would make the remaining fifth vertex adjacent only to that neighbor (otherwise I has another neighbor), producing a spanning star, contrary to maximum matching size2. Thus it has size2.

In(A), sum the five saturated cycle inequalities with weights1/2, or the three triangle inequalities with weights1/2 plus the disjoint edge with weight1. These give sum_i n_i>=5t. No safe static reserve exists for ANY t.

In(B) with |I|3, N(I)={a,b}, assign n_i=1 on I and n_a=n_b=2t-1. Every saturated edge is between I and N or within N; all floors hold. Total4t+1<5t for t>=2. In the star case, center2t-1 and four leaves1 give2t+3<5t. These are static witnesses. The star minimum2t+3 is inherited; the general three-set witness need not be a static minimum.

If min degree>=2 and case(B) holds, a star is impossible, and each independent vertex must meet both a and b. Thus G is K23 with optional edge ab. There are choose(5,2)*2=20 labelled graphs. The fingerprint invariant forbids every vacancy; its earlier static-minimum proof4t+1 still holds with the optional ab edge because the canonical minimizer satisfies that added floor.

## Constructive availability for weak traces
Assume t>=2. Isolated vertices were handled. More generally, whenever two degree-one vertices i,j share their neighbor a (a cherry), use the following route; every star is a special case. Use a non-anchor label from leaf i, delete its three incidences outside root ia, then ADD ONLY root ja. It now has footprint{ia,ja} within center maximum M_a. Delete the four incidences of a target label from j. This achieves a FIRST vacancy in8 toggles; one original maximal anchor from each of the four types other than j stays fixed. All saturated floors incident to the changed types hold: ia was retained and ja was compensated before deletion. Other roots lose at most two of their original2t supports and remain>=1. This improves the prior achieved16-toggle route without contradicting its explicitly nonoptimal claim. Other saturated G edges are untouched. If G has no isolated vertex,8 is globally optimal by the lower bound below; if G has an isolated vertex, the global first-reserve optimum is4 instead.

For case(B) with |I|3, N={a,b}, and min degree<=1: at least one member i of I has degree1. Indeed if each member had degree2, both neighbors would have degree>=3 and every vertex would have degree>=2. Relabel N so N(i)={a}. Since b is in N(I), choose j in I\{i} adjacent to b. Let k be the third member. Choose non-anchor donors x_i,x_j and a target label x_k; freeze one original maximal label of each type EXCEPT k (four actual anchors). Both donors are distinct from those anchors, available because t>=2.

1. Delete the three incidences of x_i outside ia. Its only saturated source edge ia stays.
2. Add a-j to x_i IF aj is an edge of G. Add a-k to x_i IF ak is an edge of G. Its footprint stays within M_a.
3. Delete the three incidences of x_j outside jb. The only possible additional saturated edge ja has already been compensated in step2.
4. Add b-k to x_j IF bk is an edge of G. Its footprint stays within M_b.
5. Delete all four incidences of x_k. Its saturated neighbors lie in{a,b} and were compensated in steps2/4.

All other floors are1. At every pair root, at most one original incidence is lost from each endpoint type, so its cardinality remains at least2t-2>=2 unless compensated above. Original domination holds through shrinking then additions into M_a/M_b. The four chosen maximal anchor labels never change and cover all ten roots; coretau4 follows. Every donor retains ia/jb, so the only first absent label is x_k at the final toggle. Achieved cost is10+1_{aj in G}+degree_G(k)<=13 toggles. No optimality claim. Arbitrary original protected hidden completions follow from the inherited safety criterion.

## Sharp lower bound without isolates
At any FIRST-vacancy endpoint let x be an absent label originally of type v. Since G has no isolated vertex, v has a saturated neighbor w. Root vw originally had exactly2t supporters, one of which was x. Its preserved floor2t forces an endpoint supporter y that did not originally contain vw. Thus y is distinct from x and originally has type k different from v,w. Domination forces its endpoint footprint into M_v or M_w, each intersecting its original M_k in only one root. Therefore y incurred at least three original-incidence deletions and one addition. Label x incurred at least four original-incidence deletions. These distinct-label costs sum to at least8 actual toggles. The argument allows arbitrary intermediate edits and moving covers. Thus a cherry attains the global first-vacancy optimum8 in a no-isolate graph; an isolated vertex gives optimum4. No optimality claim is made for the general <=13 route.

Together the static dichotomy, fingerprint obstruction and these constructions prove the claimed all-t classification and fixed-protection first-reserve existence throughout the declared family.

## Prospective complete verification contract
Before any new computation: independent proof review, author adjudication and immutable GitHub freeze.
1. Independently reconstruct all1024 labelled G at t1,2,3, complete count vertices/exact-meet edges/components/static minima/source accessible minima. Check the all-t theorem's finite classification, t1 exception, exactly20 locked/static-spare cases for t2,3, and explicit spanning/static certificates for EVERY graph. Compare full canonical identities before hashing; no outcome-selected graph omission.
2. For all1024G and t1..3, every isolated type gets its actual4-toggle route. For EVERY G with an ordered pair of distinct degree-one vertices sharing their neighbor and t2..5, EVERY such ordered cherry gets the8-toggle construction (including all12 ordered leaf pairs of each star). Its global-optimality flag is true only when G has no isolated vertex. For every labelled independent triple I with N(I) size2 in every G of min degree1, enumerate EVERY ordered (i,a,j,b,k) satisfying the stated conditions, and t2..5: each actual partial-footprint route, exact operations, anchors, first vacancy and cost<=13. Canonical actual identities: first label in each protected type is its anchor, second label in each donor type is its donor, first label in the target type is deleted. Delete roots in ascending lexicographic pair-root order; additions follow the stated order (aj,ak then bk). Isolated routes delete the first label of the chosen type and fix first labels of all other types. Every ordered certificate is enumerated, not every label choice or edit ordering. Retain identities even under symmetry. Original labels only, unchanged original floors.
3. Check every native slice and EVERY original protected one-hidden mask, deduplicated by (t,G,core) within the complete route campaign; separate occurrence counts. Actual floors/domination/upper-four and anchor immutability. Preserve proof-based arbitraryt/hidden claims distinct from finite corroboration. Explicit t1 non-isolated static obstruction; K23/optional-edge static-spare/inaccessible cases; invalid degree/independent-set/donor/anchor/fresh-label/floor controls; omitted compensation must fail at the corresponding saturated root when that edge exists; a floor-one edge needs no compensation. Independently enumerate every root vw, original supporter type k outside{v,w}, possible dominating container in{M_v,M_w}, and every endpoint subfootprint containing vw. Verify at least three lost original incidences and at least one new incidence, corroborating the8-toggle lower bound.
4. Genuine RED contracts, then new GREEN and312 inherited tests. Independently reconstruct the ENTIRE declared universe and canonical identities. Reject graph/t/certificate/vertex/edge/component/static/path/anchor/hidden-mask omissions or corruptions. Full fresh certificate/identity reproduction.
5. Exact-event GitHub CI; Gemini mathematical and separate publication reviews; original ZIPs/full logs/raw responses/hashes/retries; author reconciliation; fresh separate publication audit; updated continuation indices and immutable text/blob/head readback. No scientific closeout before these finish.

# Universal core-region criterion and reserved-label bypass — closeout

Status: scoped theorem CLOSED. Exact repair on the saturated disjoint-role template is OBSTRUCTED with only active labels and CONSTRUCTIVE with one reserved unused core label. Broad C3/general C4 remain OPEN. No numbered v16 or full-stack/post-merge certification is claimed.

## Scientific discovery

For an original finite nonempty core C with hitting number 3 or 4, positive original floors at most core sizes, and ALL protected completions by a disjoint nonempty hidden palette, a candidate core D is universally admissible exactly when:

1. Its core supports satisfy the original floors.
2. Its core hitting number is at most 4.
3. Every current core-label footprint is contained in some original core-label footprint (empty footprints allowed).

This removes the hidden-completion quantifier from this safety decision. Necessity uses a single hidden label on the complement of a violating footprint; sufficiency replaces current core hits by original core hits and leaves hidden hits unchanged. The original C remains the reference throughout a path. Arbitrarily many hidden labels are covered by the proof, not by extrapolation from the finite census. The criterion decides admissibility, not general connectivity or native observer origin.

The saturated template has m roots with {A}, two singleton roles {B}, {C}, and host {D,E}. With only these five active labels it has NO uniformly safe first edit across its full source fiber: deletion violates a floor in the empty-hidden world; every valid addition mixes disjoint original footprints. With one reserved globally absent core label w, use +w at host, remove D there, add D at ALL m A-roots, remove A at ALL those roots, add A at host, and remove w. Every slice is universally safe and the endpoint exactly exchanges A,D while preserving hidden incidences.

The route uses 2m+4 committed toggles, the sharp uniform minimum: 2m+2 endpoint differences plus at least two off-endpoint toggles. Peak excess is max(1,m), not a single-excess claim. Current core and the supplied ordered template identify the next request and exact endpoint. Optional NOOPs can stall forever; no physical progress law is derived.

This does not make the previous fixed-family admission predicate true. The hidden common label can persist while the SAME intended exact repair destination is reached by another route. Buffer choreography was already known; the new result is the exact universal criterion and its full-completion operational application, including resource necessity and uniform optimality. Core access, static addresses, original protected-band knowledge and reserved-label availability remain explicit premises.

## Reproducible evidence

- [Prospective scope/proof freeze](https://github.com/proteinfoldingengine/WetLabEngine/commit/49227fd7c18fe4ec358817102e1e31ff43d8c965).
- [Initial test/absent-implementation RED](https://github.com/proteinfoldingengine/WetLabEngine/commit/c53835ab4127dabd460b5b47bde955a2be61f9b6).
- [Initial scientific implementation and two added native controls](https://github.com/proteinfoldingengine/WetLabEngine/commit/9a68f2b25fccc9638366467b6ce2df9eab5e538b), run 38005748370.
- [Review correction and final executed source](https://github.com/proteinfoldingengine/WetLabEngine/commit/7f237318f5c5f5e58e3171f6755523f6777d3fc2); [final run 38006101325](https://github.com/proteinfoldingengine/WetLabEngine/actions/runs/38006101325). Proof and scientific code are unchanged between runs; review evidence/instructions were corrected.

The bounded census reconstructs 12,913 candidates: 4,096 each on three complete declared core domains and 625 empty/singleton candidates on a four-root tau4 source. Universally safe counts are 60, 6, 6, 24 respectively. The m=3 repair is checked on all 53 protected one-hidden-label completions, through all 11 slices (ten edits). These are executed counts, not prospective analytical predictions.

All 50 tests pass: four positive contracts, two explicit native rejecting controls, 16 corrupted-certificate controls, and 28 inherited fixed-family tests. Cross-role addition has a native tau 3-to-2 witness; premature deletion raises empty-world tau to 5; a separate five-root candidate rejects an omitted upper-bound condition. Complete independent reconstruction uses sets and minimum representative unions, while production uses bits and subset hitting enumeration. All canonical row values, memberships and types must match. The first RED log records one missing-producer setup error with zero tests run; the later controls RED has two actual failed assertions before their implementation.

Certificate SHA256: c67dac5120375119477996317a82df74b46d3da5068e05054a6d60d950c744ef (627695 bytes). Local, initial/final Actions and separate publication reproduction agree byte for byte. The complete certificate is retained inside original-verification.zip.

## Independent review and author adjudication

Fresh mathematical and separate publication reviews both returned ACCEPTED, with zero listed missing assumptions/counterexamples. Model: gemini-3.1-pro-preview. Reviewed hashed inputs: 21 mathematical and 24 publication. These are adversarial AI assessments, not proof-assistant certification.

The author did NOT accept the initial favorable labels without inspection. Both initial reviews reversed the cover inequality and conflated floor-failing deletions with footprint-failing additions. The [adjudication](COUPLED_C3_FOOTPRINT_REVIEW_ADJUDICATION.md) preserves the objections and requires fresh review. The correct inequality is tau(source)<=tau(current); the separate core upper-cover condition supplies tau(current)<=4. Original proof/code already used the correct argument. Fresh reviews explicitly address the corrections. Original responses and all three original archives from BOTH runs remain available.

See [accepted mathematical review](COUPLED_C3_FOOTPRINT_ACCEPTED_REVIEW.md) and [publication audit](COUPLED_C3_FOOTPRINT_PUBLICATION_AUDIT.md). Historical pending headers describe earlier stages and are superseded by this closeout.

## Next mathematical obligation

Use the exact safe-region criterion to ask when existing overlapping supports can release a reusable label while preserving floors and the actual target, eliminating a separately reserved-label premise where native structure permits it. The saturated disjoint template rules out a universal affirmative answer, so any positive condition must identify real overlap or capacity and prove a valid path. Do not infer availability by inspecting hidden supports or assume a finer source fiber that the controller has not acquired.

The current theorem does not cover hidden-label operations, restricted correlated fibers, floors above core sizes, root creation/deletion or general exact-target connectivity. # Anchored donor release and exact-permutation restoration — scoped closeout

Status: **CLOSED for the declared two-stage monotone-release theorem and its exact verification contract.** Broad C3/general C4, native observer/core access, source admission, outcome selection, and guaranteed progress remain OPEN. This is not numbered-v16 or full-stack certification.

## Mathematical result

For a finite original core `C`, active palette `P`, fixed positive original floors, and `3 <= tau(C) <= 4`, fix an occupied reserve label `r`. A two-stage path that first adds only non-`r` donor incidences and then deletes every original `r` incidence exists uniformly over every original protected hidden completion exactly when each donor `d != r` can be assigned to an inclusion-maximal original footprint `phi(d)` such that:

1. its original footprint is contained in `phi(d)`;
2. the assigned donor incidences satisfy every original floor; and
3. at most four assigned donor footprints cover all roots.

The construction is explicit. Add donor incidences within their assigned original footprints, then delete `r`. Original floors, original-footprint domination, and an actual upper-four cover hold at every slice. This criterion is exact only for the declared monotone class; its failure is not a general connectivity obstruction.

Once `r` is absent, whole-footprint renames implement any exact palette permutation, including one moving `r`. Concatenating the release path, the rename path, and the reverse of the permuted release path reaches exactly the labelled endpoint `pi(C)`, fixes every hidden incidence, and removes all preparatory donor incidences in their prescribed images. Relabelling the same certificate renews the interface for any finite prescribed permutation sequence.

The saturated multi-donor example `({r,a},{r,b},{a,c},{b,d},{e})` shows the new mechanism: two donors protect distinct maximal regions, so a common donor backbone is unnecessary.

## Verification and independent review

The analytical result and prospective scope were frozen at `ff482f62399bdf71774baf8923008e561035a47e`. The implementation ran at `06f8e31cf286cf9da204feef038ac0153bb10bd9`; its original artifacts, full logs, internal review and publication audit were preserved before the exact-commit external campaign.

- Exact event-commit provenance passed; the certificate was independently reconstructed byte-for-byte.

- The publication gate verified 27 review inputs, response hashes, exact provenance, byte-identical reproduction, and complete independent reconstruction.

All three original external-review ZIPs, complete logs, raw responses, manifests, the publication gate, archive digests, and the prior genuine local RED are preserved under `evidence/anchored-release/external-review/`. Failure for one reserve is insufficient if another reserve is releasable. A positive construction or invariant must preserve original floors, footprint domination, and the upper-four cover at every slice.

# Maximal-footprint handover graph — scoped scientific closeout

Status: **CLOSED for the declared universally safe core-connectivity theorem and its verification contract.** Broad C3/general C4, native observer/access/source/outcome/progress and universal one-excess-incidence repair remain OPEN. No numbered-stage or full-stack certification.

## Exact mathematical result
For a finite original core with active labelled palette, fixed positive floors at most original root sizes and original hitting number 3..4, let M be its inclusion-maximal original label footprints. Keep ALL original protected hidden completions fixed.

Build vertices by assigning each existing label a member of M or the empty footprint, subject to original floors and an actual at-most-four-label cover. Join two vertices differing in one label exactly when their intersection core satisfies those same conditions. Original-footprint domination follows by construction.

Two uniformly safe labelled cores are connected by safe single incidence toggles **if and only if** their maximal expansions lie in the same assignment component. The expansion choices do not affect the answer. Proof constructs both directions: expand source; compress incidence edits, handling empty bridges; lift handover edges by deletion to their safe intersection then addition inside the new original container; reverse target expansion to reach the EXACT labelled destination. Every original hidden completion stays safe, with no reset, hidden read/write, new label/root or floor relaxation.

A prescribed occupied label can be freed exactly when the source component contains that empty coordinate. Such a path, followed by inherited absent-label renaming and reverse of its permuted release path, implements any exact core-label permutation and restores every preparatory incidence in its prescribed image. The interface renews for finite permutation sequences.

This decides finite connectivity in the declared model, including nonmonotone paths. It does not guarantee a vacancy in every component or identify an efficient structural characterization. Bound (|M|+1)^N is exponential; each edge lift costs its changed footprint symmetric difference. No global optimality or physical scheduler is derived.
